name: Round Robin Brainstorming

steps.text: Arrange seats in a circle and state the rule plainly: sketch, pass left, build, pass left, harden.
Round one: each person seeds a concept in zone one of their sheet, with a headline and a rough sketch.
Round two: pass left, read the seed, add one enhancement in zone two, and neither erase nor evaluate.
Round three: pass left again, name the concept's biggest failure point in zone three, and design a patch.
Return each sheet to its originator and have them read the chain of additions aloud to the group.

failure: Half-working looks like zone two filled with objections to the seed instead of additions: the chain stops evolving and each sheet becomes three separate opinions.
intervention: Say: accept the seed as a given and answer it with yes-and. Replace any critique in zone two with one concrete enhancement.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A long-standing group technique for chained iteration; no origin given in the source.
